blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Gabriel Go from the Metro Manila Development Authority (MMDA) will be in charge of the Epifanio delos Santos Avenue (Edsa) busway operations. This comes as he assumes the role of assistant secretary under the Department of Transportation (DOTr), Transport Secretary Vince Dizon said on Wednesday. According to Dizon, Go will replace DOTr Assistant Secretary Jose Lim. Before transferring to the agency, Go headed the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority’s Special Operations Group – Task Force for Road Clearing.
